page_title: LAZ 4-1 SAL | Lazio v Salernitana 12/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' The ball flies way wide of the left post as Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) produces an imprecise volley strike from long distance. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Salernitana.

90+3' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Lazio are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
89' 5 additional min. will be played.

87' 4 - 1 Goal! Great link up play between Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) and Nicolo Rovella gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the bottom left corner. 4:1.
85' We are about to witness a substitution. Agustin Martegani (Salernitana) is replacing Antonio Candreva.
84' Igor Tudor has decided to make a change. Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) replaces Mario Gila.

83' Lazio slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) comes onto the pitch for Matias Vecino.
80' Substitution. Pedro (Lazio) has come on for Taty Castellanos.
80' Here is a change. Luis Alberto is going off and Igor Tudor gives the last tactical orders to Danilo Cataldi (Lazio).
79' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Luis Alberto (Lazio) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
76' Shon Weissman (Salernitana) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi.
73' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Salernitana.
73' Lassana Coulibaly (Salernitana) is penalised for a foul. Luca Zufferli had a clear view and blows his whistle.
70' Lorenzo Pirola (Salernitana) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
67' Flag goes up against Luis Alberto (Lazio) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
67' Ball possession – 67:33.
64' Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
63' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) meets a cross inside the box, but Christos Mandas wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.

61' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Luis Alberto (Lazio) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Benoit Costil pulls off a brilliant save.
59' Lazio are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
58' It's time for a substitution. Elseid Hysaj (Lazio) comes on in place of Adam Marusic.
56' He should have scored! Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
53' Wonderful movement by Lazio. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
52' Matias Vecino (Lazio) commits a foul during an attacking move.
51' Daichi Kamada picks out Felipe Anderson (Lazio) unmarked inside the box, but he blazes the ball well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Salernitana will have a goal kick.
50' The statistic for corner kicks – 9:0.
48' The resulting corner from Luis Alberto (Lazio) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
46' The referee allows time for a substitution. Alessandro Zanoli will be replaced by Mateusz Legowski (Salernitana).
46' Stefano Colantuono has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Junior Sambia (Salernitana) replacing Jerome Boateng.
46' That will be all from Giulio Maggiore who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Konstantinos Manolas (Salernitana).
46' Luca Zufferli blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' Giulio Maggiore (Salernitana) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

45+1' Luis Alberto sprays a pass out to Adam Marusic (Lazio), but he produces a poor effort from inside the box which goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Salernitana.
45+1' Lazio failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
45+1' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. It will be a corner kick for Lazio.
44' Lazio take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
43' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Luis Alberto (Lazio). Lazio will take a corner kick.
40' Lazio have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
38' Patric (Lazio) sends a chip pass into the box, but Benoit Costil is quickest to intercept the ball.
36' Luca Zufferli shows a yellow card to Lassana Coulibaly (Salernitana) for his blatant foul.
35' 3 - 1 Felipe Anderson (Lazio) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a precise shot inside the left post. What a lovely finish!
34' Felipe Anderson (Lazio) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
32' Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
31' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
29' Adam Marusic (Lazio) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
28' Lassana Coulibaly (Salernitana) gets a shot from distance but fails to generate enough power to beat the goalkeeper.
26' The game is interrupted now, Taty Castellanos (Lazio) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
24' Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Christos Mandas was alert and made a comfortable save.

22' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
22' Lazio seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
20' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) sends a cross into the box, but Christos Mandas comes off his line to gather the ball.
16' 2 - 1 Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header inside the left post. Excellent finish.
14' 2 - 0 Goal! Matias Vecino (Lazio) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:0.
14' The ball goes behind for a corner. Lazio will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

14' Adam Marusic (Lazio) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. Lazio force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
12' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Luis Alberto (Lazio). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
12' Adam Marusic (Lazio) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Lazio have been awarded a corner kick.
11' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lazio.
10' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Benoit Costil.
7' 1 - 0 Felipe Anderson (Lazio) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Benoit Costil with a strike into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:0.
6' The resulting set piece from Lazio is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
5' Lazio have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
5' A quickly taken corner by Lazio.
2' Salernitana are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in.
1' The first half has just begun.
Lazio will kick-off.
Luca Zufferli will supervise the game today.
